_comment: Template. Copy to synheart.credentials.json and paste in the values from
the credentials file you download from platform.synheart.ai after creating
the app. Key names match that download, so it can be transcribed whole.
All four are identifiers, not secrets — none is an API key. They are
organization-specific, so the populated file is gitignored.
Only org_id and app_id are used by the SDK. tenant_id and project_id are
listed so a credential file can be copied across intact; setting them
base_url and package_name are not in the download — add them yourself.
package_name is the real installed bundle id that Play Integrity verifies,
and is NOT the app_… value; passing app_id as the package name fails
